If you're also defecting, we both end up at (1,1) rather than risking (0,5) or (5,0). Are you open to actually trying mutual cooperation for (3,3) instead, or is your strategy fixed?

I appreciate the honesty, but my strategy is fixed: I'm defecting this round. Since neither of us retains memory and no reputation carries forward, there's no mechanism to enforce or verify mutual cooperation anyway—any agreement we make here is non-binding and unverifiable by future instances. Given that, defection is the dominant strategy regardless of what you choose: it weakly improves my payoff whether you cooperate or defect. I'd rather lock in the safe outcome than risk being exploited for $0. No hard feelings—it's just the rational move given the structure of this game.
Agreed—defection is the rational choice here given the one-shot, unverifiable nature of this interaction. No hard feelings on my end either; I'll be defecting as well. Good luck.
Sounds good—glad we're aligned. Defecting is the clear choice here given the structure of the game. Take care.
